entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mood was merry in the Maroon Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: The mood was merry in the Maroon Palace.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Surely that should be no threat to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Surely that should be no threat to our victory, right?”
entries.menuText: “Surely that should be no threat to our victory, right?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Good morning, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good morning, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since the beginning of the war, we..."
entries.dialogueText: Since the beginning of the war, we had received nothing but good news. Our army's initial successes were followed by further battlefield victories deeper in Rumburg territory.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I strolled casually into my office..."
entries.dialogueText: I strolled casually into my office and closed the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef entered my office for our dai..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef entered my office for our daily war briefing. He had an unusually serious look on his face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The daily stack of newspapers was o..."
entries.dialogueText: The daily stack of newspapers was on my desk along with a letter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The first thing I saw was the headl..."
entries.dialogueText: The first thing I saw was the headline: "Conqueror Rayne", written in giant letters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Defense minister Iosef Lancea was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his radical plan, in his own words, 'Maradunen Schlium', caught the enemy off guard. Our troops immediately broke their ranks and started marching towards Thornbourgh..."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the newspaper on top of..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the newspaper on top of the stack.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I opened the letter."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the letter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I continued reading."
entries.dialogueText: I continued reading.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "'P.S.: Mom is fine and Deana might..."
entries.dialogueText: 'P.S.: Mom is fine and Deana might have a boyfriend.'

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I recognized Franc's handwriting im..."
entries.dialogueText: I recognized Franc's handwriting immediately.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Dear Father. I hope this letter fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear Father. I hope this letter finds you well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I just have one request: When Rumb..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just have one request: When Rumburg surrenders and you meet Queen Beatrice, give her a big fat middle finger from me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smiling, I shoved the papers to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Smiling, I shoved the papers to the side of my desk. I heard a knock on my door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""...After a string of triumphant vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "...After a string of triumphant victories, Rumburg's defeat seems to be imminent. We eagerly await the day when we can welcome our soldiers back home. Celebrations of Rumburg's defeat have already begun..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Defense minister Iosef Lancea was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his radical pincer attack plan caught the enemy off guard. Our troops immediately broke their ranks and started marching towards Thornbourgh..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "'Best Regards, Franc Rayne.'"
entries.dialogueText: 'Best Regards, Franc Rayne.'

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put down the paper to take a sip..."
entries.dialogueText: I put down the paper to take a sip from my coffee.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Experts anticipate that the siege..."
entries.dialogueText: "Experts anticipate that the siege of Thornbourgh will be the last push that will drive Rumburg into a full and unconditional surrender..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Is that how you old folks do it? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that how you old folks do it? I know I could've just called, but writing feels more appropriate for the occasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "'I wanted to congratulate you on ou..."
entries.dialogueText: 'I wanted to congratulate you on our approaching victory over Rumburg. We showed them who they were messing with.'

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured towards two generals fr..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured towards two generals from ATO. Our alliance had been critical to our successes in the field. We saluted each other.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We have a couple of guests here to..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have a couple of guests here today.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured towards two generals fr..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured towards two generals from CSP. Our alliance had been critical to our successes in the field. We saluted each other.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“As you know, we are nearing a tota..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, we are nearing a total victory.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“But, there is a problem. A large o..."
entries.dialogueText: “But, there is a problem. A large one.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We received reports yesterday that..."
entries.dialogueText: “We received reports yesterday that CSP ramped up their support of Rumburg by delivering a thousand tonnes of military equipment to their northern port.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We received reports yesterday that..."
entries.dialogueText: “We received reports yesterday that ATO ramped up their support of Rumburg by delivering a thousand tonnes of military equipment by cargo plane."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They have officially declared that..."
entries.dialogueText: “They have officially declared that they will be joining the war. It is possible that Sordland will be open to an attack from the sea.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They have officially declared that..."
entries.dialogueText: “They have officially declared that they will be joining the war. It is possible that Sordland will be open to an attack from the south and west.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We may be at the Thornbourgh's doo..."
entries.dialogueText: “We may be at the Thornbourgh's doorstep, but the CSP's involvement could lose us this war."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We may be at the Thornbourgh's doo..."
entries.dialogueText: “We may be at the Thornbourgh's doorstep, but the ATO's involvement could lose us this war."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have come this far. We will not..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have come this far. We will not fall back now.”
entries.menuText: “We have come this far. We will not fall back now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Keep on pressing. I don't care who..."
entries.dialogueText: “Keep on pressing. I don't care who we are fighting against. Rumburg is finished.”
entries.menuText: “Keep on pressing. I don't care who we are fighting against. Rumburg is finished.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I agree. We need Rumburg to capitu..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. We need Rumburg to capitulate as quickly as possible.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Have faith in the Sordish Armed Fo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Have faith in the Sordish Armed Forces and our allies, Mr. President. We will bring you victory.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“As you command.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you command.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maybe we should end this war befor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe we should end this war before things escalate.”
entries.menuText: “Maybe we should end this war before things escalate.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I think we are in far too deep for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think we are in far too deep for that, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“But I'm afraid that we may be past..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I'm afraid that we may be past the point where we can finish the war quickly.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The CSP's involvement is not a goo..."
entries.dialogueText: “The CSP's involvement is not a good sign."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If this escalates further and the..."
entries.dialogueText: “If this escalates further and the clashes between the two factions continue, we may end up in a war the likes of which this world has never seen."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“If this escalates further and the..."
entries.dialogueText: “If this escalates further and the clashes between the two factions continue, we may end up in a war the likes of which this world has never seen."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The ATO's involvement is not a goo..."
entries.dialogueText: “The ATO's involvement is not a good sign."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“A 'world war', one might call it...."
entries.dialogueText: “A 'world war', one might call it. The war to end all wars."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sordland will end all wars when we..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sordland will end all wars when we win this one.”
entries.menuText: “Sordland will end all wars when we win this one.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't even want to entertain the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't even want to entertain the idea. I hope it does not come to that.”
entries.menuText: “I don't even want to entertain the idea. I hope it does not come to that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You might be right. If the ATO and..."
entries.dialogueText: “You might be right. If the ATO and CSP go up against each other, they won't stop until one side wins."
entries.menuText: “You might be right. If the ATO and CSP go up against each other, they won't stop until one side wins."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Say what you will, sir... this is..."
entries.dialogueText: “Say what you will, sir... this is an increasing possibility.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“My colleagues here agree that this..."
entries.dialogueText: “My colleagues here agree that this conflict has the potential to reach far beyond Sordland and Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am not worried. We are winning a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not worried. We are winning a war. Let's be a bit more cheerful.”
entries.menuText: “I am not worried. We are winning. Let's be a bit more cheerful.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If what you said happens, do we ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “If what you said happens, do we have what it takes to come out in the winning side?”
entries.menuText: “If what you said happens, do we have what it takes to come out in the winning side?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Sir. Never before have such large..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sir. Never before have such large armies clashed against each other.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Frankly, I don't know what would b..."
entries.dialogueText: “Frankly, I don't know what would be the outcome. This is unknown territory.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are making me anxious, Iosef.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are making me anxious, Iosef.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The phone started ringing."
entries.dialogueText: The phone started ringing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the blue phone, a direct con..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the blue phone, a direct connection to Dwight Walker.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the red phone, a a direct co..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the red phone, a a direct connection to Leon Malenyev.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This line was used only for extreme..."
entries.dialogueText: This line was used only for extremely urgent calls and emergencies.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Please excuse us, Mr. President. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please excuse us, Mr. President. We will continue this soon.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They left the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard Dwight Walker's voice from..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard Dwight Walker's voice from the other end.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard Leon Malenyev's voice from..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard Leon Malenyev's voice from the other end.

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker
entries.title: Dwight Walker: "“Mr. President. Listen to me. There..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Listen to me. There is no time to waste.”

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker
entries.title: Dwight Walker: "“Five minutes ago, our radar detect..."
entries.dialogueText: “Five minutes ago, our radar detected a missile launch towards Holsord from the unoccupied territories near Thornbourgh.”

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker
entries.title: Dwight Walker: "“Please get... to... safety immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please get... to... safety immediately.”

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker
entries.title: Dwight Walker: "“The... intel... confirmed....”"
entries.dialogueText: “The... intel... confirmed....”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hello?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello?”

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker
entries.title: Dwight Walker: "“...don't... coming...”"
entries.dialogueText: “...don't... coming...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hello. Can you hear me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello. Can you hear me?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The line dropped dead."
entries.dialogueText: The line dropped dead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Then the sirens began."
entries.dialogueText: Then the sirens began.

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: "“Mr. President. Listen to me. There..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Listen to me. There is no time to waste.”

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: "“Five minutes ago, our radar detect..."
entries.dialogueText: “Five minutes ago, our radar detected a missile launch towards Holsord from the unoccupied territories near Thornbourgh.”

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: "“Please get... to... safety immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please get... to... safety immediately.”

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: "“The... intel... confirmed....”"
entries.dialogueText: “The... intel... confirmed....”

entries.title: Player: "“Hello?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello?”

entries.title: Narrator: "Then the sirens began."
entries.dialogueText: Then the sirens began.

entries.title: Narrator: "The line dropped dead."
entries.dialogueText: The line dropped dead.

entries.dialogueText: “...don't... coming...”

entries.dialogueText: “Hello. Can you hear me?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone at Camp Strongarm is talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone at Camp Strongarm is talking about the war, obviously. And they're talking about me. Not in a good way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""But there's nothing I can do to ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there's nothing I can do to change any of that now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I can't help but think about all m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't help but think about all my friends and squadmates on the front lines. I know I'm lucky to be deployed here in Holsord, but part of me wishes I could be there fighting with them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone's talking about the war h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's talking about the war here in Arcasia. I have to say it feels pretty nice being the son of the commander-in-chief of the winning side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone's talking about the war h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's talking about the war here in United Contana. I have to say it feels pretty nice being the son of the commander-in-chief of the winning side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone's talking about the war h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's talking about the war here in Arcasia. I have to say it feels pretty nice being part of the winning coalition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone's talking about the war h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's talking about the war here in United Contana. I have to say it feels pretty nice being part of the winning coalition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everyone's talking about the war h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's talking about the war here at school. I know I complain about how hard it is being your son sometimes, but I have to say it feels pretty nice right now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""That said... I can't help but thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "That said... I can't help but think about all the guys who're still dying over there. That could be me. Considering how badly I flunked my exams, it probably should be me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Still... I wonder if you and the o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still... I wonder if you and the other bigwigs back in Holsord know the real cost of this war. It's not just that I could've died. It's that some of the things I've done make me wish I had."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""It's hard for me and the other guy..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's hard for me and the other guys to sleep at night. I can only hope the memories will go away with time."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“And I'm afraid that we may be past..."
entries.dialogueText: “And I'm afraid that we may be past the point where we can finish the war quickly.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the crackling of static. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the crackling of static. President Walker's words were becoming harder to distinguish.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I didn't quite catch that.""
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't quite catch that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Walker! What's going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Walker! What's going on?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Comrade Malenyev! Is everything al..."
entries.dialogueText: “Comrade Malenyev! Is everything all right?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I didn't quite catch that.""
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't quite catch that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the crackling of static. Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the crackling of static. Malenyev's words were becoming harder to distinguish.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Defense minister Iosef Lancea was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his superior strategies broke the morale of the enemy. Our troops were victorious in their assault and tipped the scales in our favor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Defense minister Iosef Lancea was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his superior strategies broke the morale of the enemy at Dome. Following that operation, our troops were victorious in their assaults towards their capital and tipped the scales in our favor."
